meta.title: BookHub — Runtime Architecture
meta.subtitle: Full-Stack Bookstore • Java 21 / Spring Boot 4 / Hibernate / MySQL

views.label: HTTP Request Flow
views.note: Follow an HTTP request from browser through Tomcat to controllers.

views.label: Business Logic & Data
views.note: Services enforce business rules; repositories generate CRUD via Spring Data JPA.

views.label: Checkout & Stock Deduction
views.note: OrderService orchestrates multi-table checkout across cart, books, and orders.

cards.title: Presentation Layer
items: Embedded Tomcat on port 8080, auto-configured by Spring Boot
DispatcherServlet routes /books, /cart, /orders to @RestController beans
Static assets from resources/static/ (index.html, admin.html)
Uploaded cover images served via WebMvcConfigurer: /uploads/** → file:uploads/
@CrossOrigin on all controllers enables browser CORS for any origin
All responses wrapped in ApiResponse<T> {success, message, data} via Jackson serializer

cards.title: Business Logic Layer
items: BookService: findAll, save, deleteById — direct CRUD delegation to BookRepository
CartService.addToCart: findById(bookId) → validate qty ≤ book.quantity → save CartItem
OrderService.placeOrder: fetchCart → validate each item stock → accumulate total → deduct book.quantity → wipe cart → save Order
OrderService touches 3 DB tables: reads cart_item, updates book, deletes cart_item, inserts orders
BookController.uploadImage: MultipartFile → uploads/<timestamp>_<name> → returns public URL string
Constructor injection for all services — no field injection, no try-catch in controllers

cards.title: Data Access & Persistence
items: JpaRepository interfaces → full CRUD auto-generated at runtime, zero implementation code
OrderRepository.findByUserId: derived query parsed from method name → WHERE user_id = ?
Hibernate 7.x (Jakarta): @Entity → DDL auto-update on startup, entity lifecycle, SQL generation
HikariCP: high-performance JDBC connection pool, auto-managed by Spring Boot
MySQL 8.0+ (InnoDB): ACID transactions, FK constraints (cart_item.book_id → book.id)
@Table(name="orders"): avoids MySQL reserved keyword conflict with ORDER BY

cards.title: Error Handling (GlobalExceptionHandler)
items: @ControllerAdvice: AOP-based centralized exception interception across all controllers
RuntimeException → HTTP 400 Bad Request + ApiResponse{false, ex.getMessage(), null}
Exception catch-all → HTTP 500 + ApiResponse{false, "Something went wrong", null}
Business errors: "Book not found", "Stock not available", "Cart is empty"
No try-catch in controllers — all errors flow through the global handler automatically
System errors concealed from clients — stack traces never leaked to the frontend

cards.title: Database Schema (3 Tables)
items: book: id (PK, AI) | title | author | price (DOUBLE) | quantity (INT) | image_url (VARCHAR)
cart_item: id (PK, AI) | quantity (INT) | book_id (FK → book.id) — @ManyToOne JPA relationship
orders: id (PK, AI) | total_price (DOUBLE) | user_id (VARCHAR, NOT NULL constraint)
Hibernate DDL auto-update creates/alters tables from @Entity annotations on JVM startup
spring.jpa.show-sql=true logs all generated SQL statements to console for debugging

cards.title: REST API (8 Endpoints)
items: GET /books → catalog | POST /books → add book | DELETE /books/{id} → remove book
POST /books/upload → multipart image upload, returns publicly served URL string
POST /cart/{id}/{qty} → add to cart with stock validation | GET /cart → view all cart items
POST /orders/{userId} → atomic checkout with stock deduction | GET /orders/{userId} → history
JSON via @RequestBody; path params via @PathVariable; files via @RequestParam MultipartFile
